papers.title: Multiscale stabilization for convection-dominated diffusion in heterogeneous media
papers.abstract: We develop a Petrov-Galerkin stabilization method for multiscale convection-diffusion transport systems. Existing stabilization techniques add a limited number of degrees of freedom in the form of bubble functions or a modified diffusion, which may not sufficient to stabilize multiscale systems. We seek a local reduced-order model for this kind of multiscale transport problems and thus, develop a systematic approach for finding reduced-order approximations of the solution. We start from a Petrov-Galerkin framework using optimal weighting functions. We introduce an auxiliary variable to a mixed formulation of the problem. The auxiliary variable stands for the optimal weighting function. The problem reduces to finding a test space (a reduced dimensional space for this auxiliary variable), which guarantees that the error in the primal variable (representing the solution) is close to the projection error of the full solution on the reduced dimensional space that approximates the solution. To find the test space, we reformulate some recent mixed Generalized Multiscale Finite Element Methods. We introduce snapshots and local spectral problems that appropriately define local weight and trial spaces. In particular, we use energy minimizing snapshots and local spectral decompositions in the natural norm associated with the auxiliary variable. The resulting spectral decomposition adaptively identifies and builds the optimal multiscale space to stabilize the system. We discuss the stability and its relation to the approximation property of the test space. We design online basis functions, which accelerate convergence in the test space, and consequently, improve stability. We present several numerical examples and show that one needs a few test functions to achieve an error similar to the projection error in the primal variable irrespective of the Peclet number.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多尺度输运问题的数值稳定化方法，但与有限元代理建模、不确定性量化或生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for FEA, uncertainty quantification, or constraint handling in implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on stabilization for multiscale convection-diffusion problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有稳定化方法对多尺度输运问题不够充分，需系统化降阶逼近
summary_zh.method: 基于Petrov-Galerkin框架，引入辅助变量并通过谱分解构造最优测试空间
summary_zh.result: 少量测试函数即可实现与原始变量投影误差相近的精度，与Peclet数无关
summary_zh.validation: 通过多尺度输运问题的数值算例验证了方法的稳定性和收敛性

summary_en.motivation: Existing stabilization techniques are insufficient for multiscale transport systems, motivating a systematic reduced-order approximation.
summary_en.method: A Petrov-Galerkin framework is employed with an auxiliary variable representing optimal weighting functions; local spectral problems define reduced test and trial spaces.
summary_en.result: A few test functions yield errors comparable to the projection error of the primal variable, independent of the Peclet number.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples on multiscale convection-diffusion problems demonstrate stability and accelerated convergence.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of aluminium and aluminium metal matrix composites: review
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) is gaining importance as companies begin to exploit its advantages to produce parts that will enable them to enter the market sooner, at a lower cost and/or with parts having an increased geometric complexity. Since aluminium is the second most popular engineering material after steel, its use in SLM was inevitable. In this review, we look at the SLM of aluminium and aluminium matrix composites. We explore some of the inherent difficulties in working with aluminium including the presence of a stable oxide layer, high reflectivity and thermal conductivity and poor flowability of the powder. We also review the unique microstructures that are produced during the SLM process and its effect on the mechanical properties. Included in this is the effect of heat treatment on the structure and properties. Finally, we look at the benefits and problems of producing aluminium metal matrix composites using SLM.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述铝合金选区激光熔化，未涉及生物医学植入物相关力学或材料问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a general review on SLM of aluminium and its composites, with no mention of biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述铝合金及其复合材料的选区激光熔化进展
summary_zh.method: 系统梳理文献，涵盖工艺难点、微观结构和力学性能
summary_zh.result: 指出氧化物层、高反射率等挑战，以及独特显微组织对性能的影响
summary_zh.validation: 未涉及实验验证，纯文献综述

summary_en.motivation: This review aims to consolidate the state of the art in selective laser melting of aluminium and aluminium matrix composites.
summary_en.method: The paper systematically surveys the literature on SLM processing challenges, resulting microstructures, and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: It highlights inherent difficulties such as oxide layers and high reflectivity, and discusses the unique microstructures and their effect on properties.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided as this is a literature review.

papers.title: Hip joint loading pre- and post-total hip arthroplasty: The effect of subject-specific modelling, optimization criterion and kinematics

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换前后髋关节载荷的个性化建模，可能为股骨假体的有限元分析提供载荷边界条件。
llm.why_not_core: Does not directly quantify femoral stem stress shielding or micromotion; focuses on hip joint loading rather than bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究全髋关节置换前后髋关节载荷的变化
summary_zh.method: 采用个性化肌骨模型，结合优化准则和运动学数据
summary_zh.result: 揭示了不同建模参数对置换前后髋关节载荷的影响
summary_zh.validation: 基于模拟案例，未提及实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand changes in hip joint loading before and after total hip arthroplasty using subject-specific models.
summary_en.method: Subject-specific musculoskeletal modeling with optimization criteria and kinematic inputs.
summary_en.result: Loading patterns differ pre- vs post-THA depending on modelling choices.
summary_en.validation: Validation is based on simulation cases; no experimental data reported.
